text: dsh-ollama-tool-guard 是面向 DSH Web 的工具调用审阅插件：它接入工具执行前阶段，结合固定规则与本机 Ollama System One 决策模型，对调用给出通过或需要确认的结果，并提供 Web 设置面板调整模型、阈值和审阅选项。面板还可查看近期判定。默认连接本机 Ollama；选择 Ollama 的 cloud 模型时，审阅调用会发送到服务提供方。

dsh-ollama-tool-guard reviews DSH Web tool calls before execution with rules and an Ollama System One model, passing them through or asking for confirmation. Its settings panel adjusts thresholds and shows decisions. The default model is local; cloud models send reviewed calls to their provider.
希望 DSH 在工具运行前先让我确认需要留意的调用。
想用本机 Ollama 模型为 agent 的工具调用做判读。
I want to tune tool review thresholds and inspect recent decisions in the DSH web settings.
dsh-ollama-tool-guard 的功能「执行前判读」：在 DSH 工具执行前检查调用，可按配置直接放行，或返回确认提示；判读由固定规则和 Ollama System One 模型完成。
dsh-ollama-tool-guard 的功能「Web 设置与记录」：在 Settings → Plugins → Tool Guard 面板调整判读选项和模型连接，保存后用于后续调用，并查看近期判定记录。
dsh-ollama-tool-guard 使用 Ollama cloud 模型时，会把审阅调用发送给服务提供方；默认模型为本地 clef-flash，且调用参数默认会随判读请求发送。

**A second opinion on every tool call your DeepSeek Harness agent makes — from a model running on your own machine.**

dsh-ollama-tool-guard README · dsh-ollama-tool-guard：Your agent can read any file, run any command and fetch any URL the sandbox allows. This plugin puts a small local model in front of each call. Ordinary ones pass silently. Risky ones come back to you as an approval prompt that says what the model thinks the call does and whether it acts inside or outside your workspace.

If the model cannot be reached, nothing runs. The guard fails closed rather than letting calls slip past unreviewed.

dsh-ollama-tool-guard README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x
- [Ollama](https://ollama.com) 0.35.1 or newer (0.40.6+ if you use a `:cloud` model) — this uses its System One decision API
- About 6 GB of disk for the default model

dsh-ollama-tool-guard README · Install：**1. Pull the model** (once, ~6 GB):

```
ollama pull clef-flash
```

**2. Install the plugin:**

```
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ollama-tool-guard
```

**3. Restart `dsh web`.**

**4. Open Settings → Plugins → Tool guard.**

If the plugin does not appear under Settings, add `"dsh-ollama-tool-guard"` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json` and restart again — installing the package and registering it as a bundle are two separate steps.

dsh-ollama-tool-guard README · What you will see：When a call is surfaced, the prompt reads like a sentence:

```
tool-guard · DELETING · outside workspace · hard to undo · bash · rm -rf /srv/data
```

Left to right: what the model believes the call does (`READING`, `WRITING`, `MODIFYING`, `DELETING`, `SYSTEM CHANGE`), whether it acts inside or outside your workspace, why it was flagged in plain words, then the tool and a short summary. Approve to run it, reject to block it. Nothing runs while the prompt is open.
dsh-ollama-tool-guard README · What you will see：Everything is adjustable while the harness runs — **Settings → Plugins → Tool Guard**. Changes apply to the next call, no restart:

dsh-ollama-tool-guard README · Choosing a model：The judge is whatever your own Ollama serves. Any decision model works; these three are the ones this was built against:

| `model` | Runs on | Size | What leaves your machine |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clef-flash` *(default)* | your GPU | 9B, ~6 GB | nothing — fast enough for a per-call gate |
| `clef` | your GPU | 27B, ~18–20 GB | nothing — the more careful local option |
| `clef:cloud` | Ollama's provider | — | each reviewed call |

dsh-ollama-tool-guard README · Choosing a model：Change it in **Settings → Plugins → Tool guard → Connection**. The **Test saved config** button sends one probe question and reports the latency, or exactly what went wrong.

dsh-ollama-tool-guard README · What leaves your machine：With the default local model: nothing. Every review is a request to your own Ollama, so command lines, file contents and URLs stay on the box. A `:cloud` tag sends each reviewed call to the provider instead.

The audit log records what was decided, never the text of the call. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for the full picture, including the gaps.

dsh-ollama-tool-guard README · Where things live：| | |
|---|---|
| Config | `~/.dsh/tool-guard.json` — re-read on every call, so edits apply immediately |
| Audit log | `~/.dsh/tool-guard-audit.jsonl` — one line per call |
| Settings | **Settings → Plugins → Tool guard** — model, endpoint, thresholds, effect classes, test button |

dsh-ollama-tool-guard README · If something goes wrong：| Symptom | Cause and fix |
|---|---|
| Every tool call is denied | The guard cannot reach its model. Check `ollama list` has the model pulled, and that the endpoint in Settings is right. The denial message names the model and the fix. |
| `the user rejected tool "…"` and you were never asked | The session has no approval surface — a delegated or headless run, or prompts disabled. Use `skip` or `enabled: false` for unattended work. |
| Prompts on things you find harmless | Raise the matching threshold, or untick the effect class in Settings. The prompt tells you which rule fired. |
| Plugin code changes do not apply | The host caches modules. Restart `dsh web`. |
